name: amoo
description: amoo: AI-driven mobile testing for iOS simulators and Android emulators.

plugins.name: amoo
plugins.description: Drive and verify iOS simulators and Android emulators from any AI agent: the amoo subagent, the driving-amoo and device-verifier skills, and the amoo MCP server. Requires the amoo CLI (brew install arjangconsulting/tap/amoo).

plugins.name: amoo-live
plugins.description: Claude Code only, experimental: a live pane mirroring the device amoo drives, with the session's recent actions, a status line and toasts on failed assertions. Requires the amoo CLI and MCP server.
